scope: Target-owned peptide identity and cellular-to-physiological control selection. No tumor response or GLP-1 receptor specificity is inferred.

publication.title: Prohormone cleavage prediction uncovers a non-incretin anti-obesity peptide

units.cells: Fos expression relative to vehicle. Three biological replicates except NS-1 R3A with one technical error.
units.feeding: Cumulative food intake, grams. Three independent experiment means, each from three mice per group; not individual-animal observations.

repository.ownership_verification: The paper's Methods and Code availability statements link this repository.
repository.execution: The inspected get_cleavage_sites method and its regex expression are extracted from the pinned upstream AST and run on the checked-in FASTA through a small adapter. No tissue-expression network workflow or upstream FASTA writing is run.
repository.license: No LICENSE file at this commit. Do not redistribute upstream source. Fetch from the original repository to reproduce.

analysis.normalization_cell: (condition mean - vehicle mean) / (BRP mean - vehicle mean)
analysis.normalization_feeding: (vehicle mean - condition mean) / (vehicle mean - BRP mean), at each selected time
analysis.candidate_rule: Descriptive threshold on absolute retained activity in each required assay, plus complete source replicates. This is a shortlist rule, not a statistical equivalence test.
analysis.missing_values: Exclude the author's * technical error from numerical summary, preserve its missingness flag, and require a repeat before candidate acceptance.
analysis.uncertainty: Show original biological replicate values or independent experiment means, and SD; do not claim independent mouse-level uncertainty or pair replicate columns across experiments.
analysis.normalized_reference: Vehicle Fos values fixed at 1 are already normalized, not zero raw assay variance. Normalized replicate spreads condition on reference means and are not confidence intervals.
analysis.source_summary_difference: The 10d summary sheet is not used. Its aggregation of feeding percentages differs from the ratio of group means here; its BRP Neuro2a summary 58.3293069 also differs from the 10b replicate mean 61.6626402. This is recorded without claiming the cause is known.
analysis.reusability: Apply the same schema to a new peptide panel after preserving sequence/lot identity, reporter and viability controls, biological batch IDs, dose, duration and treatment context.

reuse_constraints: The paper and data are publicly accessible but the article is publisher-exclusive. This site contains minimal numerical facts and independently computed outputs, not the source workbooks, article figures or upstream repository code.
not_established: A precursor motif does not prove processing, amidation, secretion or receptor engagement.
Fos activation is not tumor growth.
An alanine mutant with low mean activity is not a proven receptor-specific negative control.
No measured BRP effect is transferable to semaglutide without experiments.
A single dose and small number of replicates cannot establish equivalence or mechanism.
Thresholds are user-adjustable triage assumptions, not paper-specified cutoffs.
